parsed_json.up: Select molecule ChEMBL ID aliased as compound_chembl_id, canonical SMILES, compound key, PubMed ID or DOI, assay description, standard type, standard relation, standard value, standard units, activity comment, target ChEMBL ID, target name, and target organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to molecule_dictionary as an INNER JOIN to enforce SMILES presence. Join docs to assays via assays.doc_id as a LEFT JOIN to retrieve publication provenance. Filter by target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1855 and standard_type IC50. Keep only rows where canonical_smiles is not null and either docs.doi or docs.pubmed_id is not null. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication.
